public_use_rule: Use as CY2025 trust-fund financing context for HI/Part A. Do not merge directly with FY2025 OMB outlays without a calendar-year/fiscal-year bridge.
notes: HI is the payroll-financed Medicare component; the Trustees table reports income, expenditures, net increase, fund balance, asset ratio, and expenditures as a share of taxable payroll.

public_use_rule: Use as CY2025 trust-fund financing context for Part B. Do not call Part B payroll-funded; premiums and general-fund contributions are the core financing sources.
notes: Part B income includes premium income, government contributions, and interest/other. Expenditures include benefit payments and administrative expenses.

public_use_rule: Use as CY2025 trust-fund financing context for Part D. State payments and premium subsidies must remain visible; do not call Part D payroll-funded.
notes: Part D values converted from Trustees table thousands of dollars to billions of dollars.
